attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the account is the Tarracina one: Caesarius the deacon out of Africa, the temple of Apollo thrown down at his prayer, Julian the presbyter baptising the hypatikos Leontius, both martyrs sewn into sacks by the tyrant Loxorios and drowned, and Loxorios bitten by a snake on that same shore two days later as Julian had foretold. The page states «έζησαν στα χρόνια του Καίσαρα Κλαυδίου του Β' γύρω στο 268 μ.Χ.», so a `dates` object is proposed from its own words. It prints no hymn for either of them. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The same day keeps Leontius, who is drafted as a new folder in batch el-10-07-2, and «Άγιοι Ευσέβιος ο Πρεσβύτερος και Φίληξ», the two who buried them; the corpus's existing Eusebius and Felix pair is kept on the Romanian 19 octombrie with the ranks the other way round, and is deliberately neither linked nor upgraded here.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (24 September 2026).
